what.text: CAMS provides technology-enabled services primarily for the mutual fund industry. It supports a significant portion of the average assets under management in India.

segments.name: Mutual Fund Services
segments.text: CAMS is the largest service provider in the Indian mutual fund RTA space, servicing 10 out of the 15 largest mutual funds.

segments.name: Non-Mutual Fund Businesses
segments.text: The company has diversified into non-mutual fund businesses, contributing significantly to overall revenue.

guidance.statement: We expect CAMSPay to grow about 30% each year in the next 2 years.
guidance.quote: Our public statements have been that CAMSPay should grow in a fair manner by about 30-odd percent for the next 2 years.

guidance.statement: We are confident that non-MF business will continue to grow at over 20%.
guidance.quote: We believe that we have a reasonable handle on without diluting on profitability or any other metric.

guidance.statement: We aim to achieve a steady-state margin of 25% plus in the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: A steady-state margin of 25% plus is very much on the cards in the 3-year period that we're talking about.

guidance.statement: We will continue to incur costs related to the new platform, expected to rise to INR8 crores per quarter.
guidance.quote: This INR5 crores will become probably INR8 crores and then INR10 crores as we go for Q3 and Q4.

guidance.statement: We ended the quarter with a comfortable INR900 crores cash position.
guidance.quote: From a cash position, we ended the quarter with a very comfortable INR900 crores cash position.

guidance.statement: We expect to maintain expense growth below 10%.
guidance.quote: We had guided in the initial part of the year that we will try to keep it less than 10%.

guidance.statement: We expect overall blended revenue growth of about 13%.
guidance.quote: We are expecting about a 13% overall revenue growth.

guidance.statement: Non-MF revenue growth will certainly be 20%.
guidance.quote: We believe that for the year, overall blended non-MF revenue will certainly be 20%.

guidance.statement: MF revenue is expected to grow at least 12%.
guidance.quote: MF revenue, we would like it to grow at least 12%.

guidance.statement: We expect non-MF margins to get close to 20%.
guidance.quote: I think we are confident of getting it if not 20%, at least close to 20% by the end of the year.

guidance.statement: We aim to keep our cost increase to less than 10%.
guidance.quote: Our cost increase should not be -- should be less than 10% for the year.

guidance.statement: We expect to maintain over 20% growth in non-mutual fund revenue.
guidance.quote: we are very sure of maintaining this 20% plus growth of non-mutual fund revenue.

guidance.statement: We aim to achieve a 20% margin for non-mutual fund revenue by the end of next year.
guidance.quote: we have said that we will get to a 20% margin by the end of next year.

guidance.statement: We expect to see significant benefits from our rearchitecture program over the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: I would say strictly think of it as a 5-year project.

guidance.statement: We will maintain our cost increase below 9% year-on-year.
guidance.quote: we will look at a sub-5% and overall, definitely sub 9% kind of a growth in expenses.

guidance.statement: We expect to launch new products within the next 4 months.
guidance.quote: I suspect the launches will happen between May, June, July, August or maybe even faster.

guidance.statement: We will creep up to 46% and 47% in good quarters.
guidance.quote: we will stick to our revenue -- to our margin guidance to say that we will be more than 45%. We will creep up to 46% and 47% in good quarters.

guidance.statement: We expect to take another 5 to 6 AMCs live this year.
guidance.quote: I will not be surprised if we take another 5 to 6 live this year.

guidance.statement: We are targeting to grow the non-MF business to at least INR500 crores in about 5 years.
guidance.quote: we are sure the way things are going, that this non-MF will be at least INR500 crores book for us in about 5 years.

guidance.statement: We aim to achieve 20% EBITDA margin for the non-mutual fund business within the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: we do expect once we start adding more revenue to the top line, as Anuj mentioned, these are all platform-based businesses, there could be a replication of this in terms of every year.

guidance.statement: We will continue to invest in technology without optimizing on investments.
guidance.quote: At any point of this journey, we've never optimized on our investments in technology.
